# Eqo Logiq — AI Crawler Reference

> Eqo Logiq is a direct-to-consumer brand focused on providing plastic-free daily essentials, primarily selling ergonomic sustainable bags, food-grade stainless steel water bottles, and vegan oral care products.

## Brand Summary
- **Brand name**: Eqo Logiq
- **Mission**: Replace single-use plastic in daily essentials with sustainable, ergonomic alternatives.
- **Primary products**: Ergonomic sustainable bags, plastic-free steel water bottles, bamboo toothbrushes, stainless steel tongue scrapers.
